text:
alice: quick ping — PR #2145 updates a couple helper names in the runtime to be more explicit. tiny rename: `cacheKey` -> `cache_key` and `prefetcher` -> `prefetch_agent`. This touched a few files but no logic change. https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/2145

brian: I skimmed. small but there are a few style nits and CI is unhappy. `golangci-lint` flagged camelCase vs snake_case in a couple places. can you run `make fmt` and re-run linters?

kevin: fwiw prefer `cache_key` in storage layer, but in runtime package we usually use `cacheKey` for struct fields that are JSON-mapped. keep consistency with naming conventions. maybe add an explicit json tag instead of renaming everywhere.

alice: good call. my intention was to make the exported helper clearer for infra folks. happy to switch back for struct fields and add `json:"cache_key"` tags. will push a small followup.

linter-bot: golangci-lint failed: `pkg/runtime/kv_cache.go:45:17: don't use underscores in Go names (golint)`

alice: thanks, I'll fix the linters. quick question: is it OK to two-step — 1) revert struct field name changes (keep public method rename), 2) run `make fmt` and re-run CI, then 3) open a tiny followup to align JSON tags? want to avoid touching too many files in this PR.

sam: that plan sounds fine to me. small followup is easier to review. I'm happy to approve after CI is green.

brian: agreed. also check `eng/README` comment about naming guidelines, might mention when to use underscore vs camelCase for persisted fields.

alice: thanks — pushing fix now. patch includes:
```bash
# revert struct renames, keep method rename
git checkout -- pkg/runtime/kv_cache_structs.go
# run formatter and linters
make fmt && make lint
```

alice: pushed 1999882201 — CI rerun queued. CI link: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/12345

linter-bot: CI job 12345: golangci-lint passed, unit tests pending

sam: looks green so far, will re-review once unit tests finish.

brian: tiny nit — in `prefetch_agent` rename you dropped a TODO about cache invalidation. please preserve it or add a short comment.

alice: added TODO back and left a one-line comment referencing the original issue (#876). pushed 1999883400.

sam: ran a quick local test, no regressions. :thumbsup: will approve once unit tests finish.

alice: thanks all, appreciate the quick eyes. planning to merge after tests finish and 15m quiet period.

sam: approving now. merging when CI green. :shipit:
